# Joplin for ChatGPT and MCP

> Authenticated ChatGPT Actions and Streamable HTTP MCP access to self-hosted
> Joplin, plus automated headless deployment and reviewable Markdown sync.

Canonical documentation: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/joplin-md-sync

## Start here

- Overview: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/user/OVERVIEW/

## Agent safety

- Pull before editing.
- Keep managed metadata headers intact.
- Review a three-way diff and `push --dry-run` before a real push.
- Do not edit `.joplin-sync/`.
- Do not interleave MCP writes with unpushed local edits.
- Do not expose the Joplin Data API to a network.
- Never put a Joplin, MCP, Actions, sync, or encryption token in chat, Git, or
  command arguments.
